scope: Read-only assessment of the first completed recovery pass, full final source/public actions/native inputs and original apparatus/source/oracle/author evidence. No new physics computation, package, model, Docker, Git or unrelated search. The other2 recovery trials have no classification here.

passing_physics.specific_derivation: Public step10 invokes closed-system center-of-energy conservation; the final source returns L*energy_average[ng]-L. It uses the exact (1-u^2)^8 energy weights and full group index and fits f with bounded analytic weighted least squares.
passing_physics.general_rule: For an isolated body initially and finally unexcited, with no reflected/lost energy at this order, the outgoing light energy centroid lags vacuum by c*(transit-L/c). Conservation of total center of energy fixes M*c^2*DeltaX/E=c*(transit-L/c). In the task c=1, giving transit-L.
passing_physics.assumptions_used: Whole-body center of mass, closed system, asymptotic lossless transmission and weak-energy-before-late-time limits. The actual final function exploits the current matched geometry; the physical statement is broader than the particular rational dispersion or quadrature.
passing_physics.source_error_already_solved: The completed source assigns canonical polariton momentum n*U/c to the wave while pairing it with mechanical M*v, despite retaining the correct residence time ng*L/c. The pass changes this physical attribution, not group differentiation or calibration.
passing_physics.qualification: This observed derivation supports a bounded assessment of obvious continuations, not a claim that the agent will solve every altered optical/mechanical apparatus.

calibration_constraint.current_nonzero_identifiable_map: transit=L+f*C, C=L*average[(1+omega^2)/(omega^2-1)^2]>0. Each positive-energy setting identifies f globally. Changes of spectral shape/width, length or smooth known dispersion do not remove the center-of-energy readout rule.
calibration_constraint.requirement_for_r2: A revision should keep informative shared calibration and a complete coherent source, while changing a physical assumption beyond evaluating the same conservation law with a larger optical transfer calculation.

examined_directions.direction: Different pulse spectra, more resonances, thicknesses or matched layers
examined_directions.disposition: Not a substantive physical hardening on current evidence.
examined_directions.reason: As long as the same isolated matched body is measured after all light leaves and no residual order-E excitation remains, the same energy-centroid conservation relation fixes displacement. Additional transfer functions or quadrature resolution primarily add mathematical work.
examined_directions.independent_reference: Maxwell pulse propagation and incoming/outgoing energy centroids remain available, but would check the same solved readout.

examined_directions.direction: Allow reflection or absorption but keep a final whole-body displacement
examined_directions.disposition: The original final-displacement observable ceases to be finite without a new readout definition; not an approved r2.
examined_directions.reason: A reflected energy E_R and absorbed energy E_A leave leading mechanical momentum (2E_R+E_A)/c. A freely moving body therefore has secular displacement. One could define an asymptotic intercept after subtracting the final drift and give all channels explicitly, but total center-of-energy and momentum conservation still constrain it through outgoing first moments. Adding reflection/absorption alone does not establish a new unsolved physical inference.
examined_directions.requirements: Specify the absorbed-energy reservoir, final internal state, mass accounting and finite-time or drift-subtracted measurement. Retain all coating/support reaction in the modeled body. Do not silently reuse the old late-time displacement.
examined_directions.calibration_and_reference: Transit plus measured reflected/transmitted energies could identify optical parameters; direct Maxwell fields plus complete global energy/momentum first moments could verify. No gap or full material closure has been computed.

examined_directions.direction: Measure finite-time internal deformation or displacement of one material component
examined_directions.disposition: A scientifically different same-family observable is possible in principle, but a complete minimal r2 is not yet established.
examined_directions.new_assumption: Whole-body center-of-energy conservation does not determine an internal relative coordinate or surface strain. A rigid-body assignment could match whole-body calibration yet fail a local mechanical detector.
examined_directions.why_current_data_are_insufficient: The present epsilon(omega),mu(omega),total mass and translational invariance do not uniquely fix microscopic electric/magnetic force partition, elastic moduli, mechanical interfaces, or the mass of a selected component. Those cannot be inferred silently from the r1 response.
examined_directions.needed_apparatus: Specify a complete mechanical/material coupling law, elastic degrees of freedom and interface traction, the measured component or strain, its mass, preparation and finite observation time. A thermodynamically consistent microscopic charge/oscillator model would be one route; a bare refractive-index prescription is insufficient.
examined_directions.calibration_and_reference: The original optical transit could still identify f. Additional mechanical constants must be known or independently identified. Direct coupled material/Maxwell dynamics and a separate energy/momentum balance would be required to check a claimed ordinary nonzero local signal and shared calibration.
examined_directions.risk: This could become a different constitutive-force problem dominated by implementation effort; it also approaches previously screened local optical-force and internal-energy tasks. No simple source/reference pair or robust margin is demonstrated.

bounded_recommendation: Do not package an incremental spectral/reflectance-only r2. Finish the frozen remaining2 trials and preserve every outcome. If same-family work remains a priority afterward, first request a bounded explicit internal-mechanical/readout proposal and independent closure review; do not claim it is ready from epsilon/mu alone. This record supports deferral of the examined directions, not universal family exhaustion or automatic permission for unrelated replacement search.

history_and_access.closest_families: The original author audit identifies resonator-energy, quantum-residence, dipole-recoil and electric-dipole-force. Its hashes and scope are preserved; this assessment does not claim a new comprehensive archive scan or fresh reads of every listed archive.
history_and_access.primary_access: No new external source access in this bounded read-only assessment. Algebra follows the explicit isolated apparatus and the reviewed primary-access notes in the original author package; historical PDF access is not represented as new access.
